import polars as pl
import re
from datetime import datetime
import math

def transform(raw: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    def clean_money(col: str) -> pl.Expr:
        return (
            pl.col(col)
            .str.replace_all(r"[\$,]", "")
            .cast(pl.Float64, strict=False)
            .round(2)
        )

    return raw.select(
        order_id=pl.col("Receipt No").str.to_uppercase(),
        line_no=pl.col("Line").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False),
        sold_at=pl.col("Sold At").str.to_datetime("%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S", strict=False),
        store=pl.col("Store").str.to_uppercase(),
        sku=pl.col("PLU").str.to_uppercase(),
        qty=pl.col("Qty").cast(pl.Int64, strict=False),
        unit_price=clean_money("Each"),
        discount=clean_money("Disc"),
        line_total=clean_money("Line Amount"),
    )
